title: mail-server: check_email_push_change with emailPush/{accountId}/... invalidProperties paths, normalization, objectHistory accept-and-drop
description:
Design: docs/design/emailpush.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: E6. Crates: jmap-mail-server. Size: M.

Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-emailpush-05 §4 invalidProperties rules (1)-(5) and "MUST include the path to each invalid value" (emailPush/{accountId}, .../filter, .../properties, .../urgency), the §4 filter/properties/urgency requirements; RFC 8620 §5.3; object-history-03 §3.1. Design: docs/design/emailpush.md §5.2, §4 "Normalized form"; decisions 9 and 10 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md.

Implement pub async fn check_email_push_change<B: EmailPushBackend>(backend, caller, change: PushSubscriptionChange) -> Result<(), BackendSetError<B::Error>> in emailpush/validate.rs, for backends to call from check_push_subscription_change (from E1). If change.changed lacks "emailPush", only rule (5) runs (the account check runs only when the change touches emailPush). Otherwise: a non-object value => path emailPush; rule 5: non-null and keys None => add "keys"; load email_push_accounts once; for each key A: unknown account or non-object config => emailPush/A; filter must decode as Option<EmailFilter>, stay within jmap_server::MAX_FILTER_DEPTH (filter_nests_deeper_than) and use only supported conditions (mail: every EmailCondition; non-mail: the 10 required + inMailbox* when object_ids + filter_conditions; metadata conditions also need urn:ietf:params:jmap:metadata in using and metadata_info::<Email>) else emailPush/A/filter; properties must decode as Vec<String> and each pass project::check_email_property (bodyValues always fails; non-mail: the 8-name minimum + id/threadId/mailboxIds when object_ids + declared extras; objectHistory passes only when mail && email_history, decision 10) else emailPush/A/properties; urgency must decode as Urgency else emailPush/A/urgency. Collect every bad path: one SetError invalidProperties ["emailPush", paths in map order, "keys" for rule 5]. On success rewrite extra["emailPush"] as the normalized BTreeMap<Id, EmailPushConfig> (defaults filled, decision 9), with every objectHistory removed from properties and the other names kept in order (decision 10). The handler from E1 echoes it.
Acceptance (one test per path): the §5 request accepted for mail:false, object_ids:true; unknown account => ["emailPush","emailPush/X"]; "A": null => emailPush/A; {"foo":1} filter => .../filter; inMailbox with neither mail nor ObjectID => .../filter; bodyValues, and id without mail/ObjectID => .../properties; "urgent" => .../urgency; keys null => ["emailPush","keys"]; two bad accounts => both paths; a filter 33 deep => .../filter; header:Subject:asText accepted for mail and rejected for an undeclared non-mail account; a metadata condition without metadata in using => .../filter; {"A":{}} normalizes to {"A":{"filter":null,"properties":[],"urgency":"normal"}}; ["from","objectHistory","subject"] with mail+email_history is stored as ["from","subject"], and with email_history false or mail false => .../properties; a change without emailPush in `changed` and a stale account passes.
